summary.headline: Astrological Topics, Folios 207–210
summary.text: Catalogue of folio sections on benefic and malefic stars, diurnal and nocturnal stars, zodiacal signs, configurations, stellar houses, triplicities, exaltations, applications, separations, rays, and planetary powers. It also lists astrological conditions including goodness, joy, affliction, proper face, co-familiarity, dodecatemorion, phase, station, and stellar positions in longitude and latitude.
